## Common WHERE Filters

```sql
-- 单日单区 (最常用)
WHERE grass_region = upper('${region}')
  AND grass_date = DATE('${grass_date}')

-- 指定 tz_type (下游通常只用 local)
WHERE grass_region = upper('${region}')
  AND grass_date = DATE('${grass_date}')
  AND tz_type = 'local'

-- 7 日滚动窗口 (用于 nd 表)
WHERE grass_region = upper('${region}')
  AND grass_date BETWEEN (DATE('${grass_date}') - INTERVAL 6 DAYS) AND DATE('${grass_date}')
  AND tz_type = 'local'

-- 过滤有 affiliate 的广告
WHERE target_affiliate_id IS NOT NULL
```

## Common JOIN Patterns

```sql
-- JOIN 广告维度表 (ads_livestream_advertise_mkt / ads_livestream_mkt)
LEFT OUTER JOIN mp_paidads.dws_advertise_livestream_performance_1d__reg_s0_live perf
  ON dim.ads_id = perf.ads_id
 AND dim.placement = perf.placement

-- 聚合到 shop_id + streamer 粒度 (dws_advertiser_livestream_performance)
SELECT shop_id, streamer_id, streamer_type,
       SUM(impression_cnt), SUM(click_cnt), SUM(order_cnt), ...
FROM mp_paidads.dws_advertise_livestream_performance_1d__reg_s0_live
WHERE grass_region = upper('${region}')
  AND grass_date = DATE('${grass_date}')
  AND tz_type = 'local'
GROUP BY shop_id, streamer_id, streamer_type

-- UNION ALL 自有 + affiliate 广告 (ads_advertise_livestream_metrics)
-- 自有直播 (target_affiliate_id IS NOT NULL) + auto/anto 直播 (account_id AS target_affiliate_id)
SELECT ... FROM mp_paidads.dws_advertise_livestream_performance_1d__reg_s0_live
WHERE ... AND tz_type = 'local' AND target_affiliate_id IS NOT NULL
UNION ALL
SELECT ..., account_id AS target_affiliate_id, ...
FROM anto_performance  -- 来自 dwd + dim 聚合，不是本表
```

## Write Lineage (生产血缘)

```
Upstream:
  mp_paidads.dwd_livestream_performance_di__reg_s0_live (主数据源)
    - ls_performance: SUM 当日指标
    - ls_order_ytd: SUM YTD 订单 (regional: T-2 to T-1; local: T-1 only)
  livestream.ls_mart_dim_streamer (主播维度)
    - dim_ls: streamer_id, streamer_type, streamer_shop_id

Production Script:
  data_paidadsmart/workflows/data_warehouse/dws/livestream/
    dws_advertise_livestream_performance_1d__reg_s0_live/Data Processing/
      dws_livestream_performance_1d__{region}_s0_live_{tz}

Partition Strategy:
  INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE dws_advertise_livestream_performance_1d__reg_s0_live
    PARTITION (tz_type = '{local|regional}', grass_region, grass_date)
  + 同时写入 region-specific 表 (dws_advertise_livestream_performance_1d__{region}_s0_live)

Regional vs Local:
  - regional: grass_date range [T-1, T]; item_id 保留; YTD from [T-2, T-1]
  - local: grass_date = T; item_id = NULL; YTD from T-1

Downstream:
  -> ads_livestream_advertise_mkt_1d__reg_s0_live (LEFT JOIN via ads_id + placement)
  -> ads_advertise_livestream_metrics_1d__reg_s0_live (UNION ALL + 多表 join)
  -> dws_advertiser_livestream_performance_1d__reg_s0_live (GROUP BY shop+streamer)
  -> dws_advertise_livestream_performance_nd__reg_s0_live (7-day rolling SUM)
  -> ads_livestream_mkt_1d__reg_s0_live (同 ads_livestream_advertise_mkt_1d)
```

## Derived Metrics (派生指标)

以下指标在 2 个以上消费者文件中被派生，源自本表基础指标：

| Derived Metric | Formula | Used In |
|----------------|---------|---------|
| has_performance | `CASE WHEN COALESCE(impression_cnt,0)+COALESCE(click_cnt,0)+COALESCE(ads_expenditure,0.0)+COALESCE(view_cnt,0)+COALESCE(order_cnt,0)+COALESCE(ads_gmv_amt,0) > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END` | ads_livestream_advertise_mkt_1d, ads_livestream_mkt_1d |
| cold_start_status | CASE on campaign-level `SUM(view_cnt)` and `SUM(order_cnt)`: 0=low/low, 1=high/low, 2=low/high, 3=high/high (threshold: 1500 views, 5 orders) | ads_advertise_livestream_metrics_1d |
| ads_ls_active_duration | `SUM(LEAST(ls_session_end, campaign_end) - GREATEST(ls_session_start, campaign_start))` where active_time > 0 | ads_advertise_livestream_metrics_1d |
